name: Angus McLeod
bio:
Angus grew up around speedway racing in rural New South Wales, spending his weekends helping his father maintain his sprint car. This early exposure ignited a passion for motorsport that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, Angus worked as a data analyst for a V8 Supercars team for several years, honing his technical skills and learning the intricacies of team management. 

He transitioned to junior formula racing, quickly establishing himself as a keen strategist with an eye for detail. Angus believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. He is known for his innovative approach to problem-solving and his ability to extract maximum performance from limited resources. His loyalty is legendary; once he commits to a team, he's in it for the long haul.

At Prema Junior, Angus is dedicated to developing young talent and building a championship-winning team. His experience in both technical and management roles makes him an invaluable asset, bridging the gap between the engineers and the drivers. He's always looking for that extra edge, that marginal gain that can make the difference between winning and losing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Angus has a focused gaze and a lean build, suggesting both intensity and endurance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, even in the chaos of the paddock.
